# lr-rewrite ledger

Session: plain Claude Code Opus, tmux session `lr-rewrite`, worktree /Users/yasyf/repos/claude/worktrees/cc-skills/lr-rewrite, branch lr-rewrite.
Order: owner m2162, 1:22 AM Nov 9 2026. Deadline: installed and drive migrated by 9:30 AM Nov 9 Pacific.

## Tooling defects

1. 01:57 Orca could not launch this session: three `orca` launches returned an unknown outcome, so the communicator started it by hand in tmux session `lr-rewrite`. The rewrite's launch path must not depend on an Orca launch whose outcome it cannot read.

2. 02:06 cci refuses every post from lane lr-rewrite ("no registry row on drive durable-agents-rebuild"), including a self-registration `--kind spawn`; only the launcher may register. A session started by hand can never report. Asked the communicator to post the spawn row. The rewrite must let a session register itself.
3. 02:07 ListAgents names this session `durable-agents-rebuild-relay [9d36cc]`, the communicator's own name: the peer name came from inherited environment, so messages meant for the communicator can land here.

4. 02:16 The old drive's supervisor posted a note to lr-rewrite demanding `--attr owner=` and per-step attrs on a plain milestone report (cci 651593). Process nags reach a session that is not a drive lane; ignored.
5. 02:07 cc-slack refuses `recommended` (and an option marked "(Recommended)") on a card without `waits`, so a non-blocking question that carries a recommendation cannot be drawn; a `waits` card would tell him the lane is stopped, which is false. Sent the cards with the recommendation stated in the body instead.
